description: This Java class defines an EnvelopeADSR, which models an Attack-Decay-Sustain-Release (ADSR) envelope for sound synthesis. It extends a base class SynthUnit and manages the state and timing of the envelope with linear ramps, allowing control over amplitude modulation in a MIDI synthesis context. It includes methods to set ADSR parameters, trigger the envelope, and compute the current envelope value.

classes.name: EnvelopeADSR
classes.description: A class modeling an ADSR envelope with linear ramps for use in MIDI synthesis.

methods.name: setAttackTime
methods.description: Sets the attack time of the envelope, ensuring it doesn't go below a minimum threshold, and calculates the attack rate based on the synth engine's frame rate.

methods.name: setDecayTime
methods.description: Sets the decay time of the envelope, with validation and rate calculation.

methods.name: setSustainLevel
methods.description: Sets the sustain level of the envelope, clamped to a minimum of 0.0.

methods.name: setReleaseTime
methods.description: Sets the release time of the envelope, with validation and rate calculation.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Triggers the attack phase of the envelope.

methods.name: off
methods.description: Triggers the release phase of the envelope.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Advances the envelope state by one frame, updating current value based on stage, and returns the current envelope amplitude.

methods.name: isDone
methods.description: Returns true if the envelope has finished its release phase.
